title: 19-Year-Old Builds $1M AI Biz
full_monologue: **Imagine building a million-dollar AI business before turning 20.** It started with curiosity and a lot of late nights. I taught myself machine learning, then built an app that solves a real-world problem. The key? Focus on user needs, not just tech. I scaled through hustle, not luck. Now, I help others do the same. What’s your AI idea?
